subject: Watchtower Observability Handoff: dashboard templates, trace probes, and tiered alert routing
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenthumb.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Watchtower: Observability handoff and runbook deliverables

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the team at Greenthumb is ready to move into the implementation phase. Before our kickoff next Tuesday we want to align on what you'll deliver as part of the "observability handoff" from CS to our ops team. Specific asks from our side:

- A dashboard pack (APM + infra + inference costs) that we can import into Grafana.
- Tracing probe suggestions for critical RPCs and inference paths (with code snippet examples).
- Error taxonomy mapping (what constitutes transient vs. actionable errors).
- An alert routing/escalation flow so our on-call knows who to page for inference regressions.
- A short runbook for incident triage we can adapt.

Can you confirm scope and deliverables + an estimated delivery date? Also tagging Marissa (our CS PM) to coordinate.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Engineering | Greenthumb AI
attachments: none

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenthumb.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Watchtower: Observability handoff and runbook deliverables

Hi Samantha — appreciate the clear list. We can own most of this as part of the standard Watchtower onboarding bundle. Proposed breakdown and dates:

1) Dashboard pack (Grafana) — templated dashboards for model latency percentiles, token/sec, host GPU utilization, and cost-by-model. Delivery: Nov 24 (JSON import + sample data). Attachment: watchtower-dashboard-sample.png

2) Tracing probes — prioritized list of 6 probe points: request ingress, tokenizer, model client, KV cache hit/miss, downstream fetch, response serializer. We’ll include code snippets for Node/Python and an instrumentation checklist. Delivery: Nov 23. Attachment: trace-probe-checklist.pdf

3) Error taxonomy — mapping of common error classes (rate-limited, OOM/driver, deserialization, bad input) with severity and recommended action (retriable vs. page). Delivery: Nov 22.

4) Alert routing & escalation — tiered policy: page infra-oncall for OOMs/driver panics (P1), notify SRE Slack for sustained tail latency (P2), email CS/PM for cost anomalies above threshold (P3). We’ll provide a runbook flow diagram and suggested PagerDuty rules. Delivery: Nov 24.

5) Runbook (incident triage) — a short runbook with play-by-play triage steps, checklists, and rollback options for model rollback and traffic split. Delivery: Nov 24. Attachment: watchtower-runbook-template.md

Next actions:
- Marissa: coordinate a 60-minute working session (ops + infra) to walk the probe list and dashboard KPIs.
- Lauren: will own auth/permission notes for dashboard access and any required service-account grants.

If that schedule works I’ll lock in the dates and start the deliverables.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenthumb.io>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Watchtower: Observability handoff and runbook deliverables

Adding a few ops notes and proposed owners: 

- Dashboard permissions: I’ll create a Grafana org role template (Viewer, Editor, Admin). Ben — I’ll need the Greenthumb list of users (emails) by EOD Nov 19 to set up.
- Probe instrumentation: Marissa — can you confirm whether Greenthumb runs the model client in a sidecar or as an embedded library? That changes the snippet we provide (gRPC interceptor vs. middleware).
- Alert routing: I propose the following escalation mapping in PagerDuty:
  * P1 (page infra-oncall) — OOM, GPU driver crash, model process down
  * P2 (notify SRE Slack + watchtower-observability channel) — sustained p95/p99 latency above baseline for >10m
  * P3 (email CS + PM) — cost delta > 30% month-over-month or new model rollout cost spike

I’ll draft the PagerDuty playbook and ping infra-oncall for a 30-minute alignment slot Nov 23 afternoon.

Marissa: assigning you to the runbook draft and to confirm the kickoff time with Samantha.

Thanks,
Lauren

---

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenthumb.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:27:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Watchtower: Observability handoff and runbook deliverables

All sounds good — thanks team. Confirming:

- Greenthumb will provide the user list and a sample traces export from our staging environment by Nov 19 EOD.
- We prefer the sidecar deployment for the model client (gRPC), so please prioritize the interceptor snippet.
- Target for the working session: Nov 23 2:00 PM PT. 

Appreciate the clear owners — looking forward to the runbook.

Best,
Samantha
